messages:
Alex - people-ops: Quick heads-up: performance review blackout next Mon 00:00 PDT -> Wed 23:59 PDT. We need reviewer coverage, swap confirmations, and mentor check-ins logged.
Maya Chen: I'll take Eng infra reviews Mon afternoon. If someone is out, what's the formal swap step?
Alex - people-ops: Swap = DM me + update the spreadsheet 'Reviewer swaps' tab. People-ops will mirror changes to HR. Link: https://redwood.example.com/ops/review-swaps
Jamal Ortiz: Requesting a swap for Tue AM due to medical appt. @Maya can cover. I updated the sheet.
Priya Patel: When exactly do the review forms auto-lock? I have two ICs finishing late.
Alex - people-ops: Forms auto-lock Wed 23:59 PDT. For exceptions, request by Tue 18:00 here with a short reason. LOA/caregiving are considered separately.
Samir - calibration-chair: For ad-hoc calibration slots, ping me or drop in #calibration-requests. We'll approve based on conflicts.
Maya Chen: Suggestion: add a 'mentor check-in' slot to the manager invite template — 30 min pairing for draft review. New managers could be buddy-paired with senior PMs.
Alex - people-ops: Agree. Use this blurb for invites:
"""
Reminder: please schedule a 30-minute mentor check-in before Wed to review draft write-ups and raise any calibration questions.
"""
people-ops-bot: Reminder: 72-hour notice — review forms due in 72 hours. https://redwood.example.com/forms (automated)
Jamal Ortiz: Confirmed swap with @Maya. Thanks everyone.
Priya Patel: If I need a last-minute calibration slot Thu AM, do I request here or DM Samir?
Alex - people-ops: Either here (public is fine) or DM Samir. We'll approve and update the schedule. Final drop-in office hour Wed 10:00 PDT — invite coming.
people-ops-bot: Event created: Final Review Drop-in — Wed 10:00 PDT.
Maya Chen: All set on my end. Thanks!
